Oracle workforce shrinks by about 21,000 employees amid AI adoption

Oracle's NYSE:ORCL total workforce declined 13%, or about 21,000 employees in fiscal 2026, as the cloud computing giant continued restructuring its business, partly driven by the adoption of AI across its operations.The company had a total workforce of 141,000 as of May 31, 2026, compared with abou.
